load_scale_dict_from_json: load scale factors from a JSON file mapping scale factor names to values
load_scale_dict_from_pt: load scale factors from a PyTorch pickled .pt file mapping names to values
load_scale_dict_from_dict: load scale factors directly from a Python dictionary of names to values
load_scales_into_module: load scale factors from a file or dict and apply them to a PyTorch module
review_load_scales_compat: review the load_scales_compat function that applies scale factors to ScaleFactor submodules
